source.scope_ko: PX4 원래 명령을 16 V 벤치 throttle에 대응시킨 부하 근사다. 실제 RPM, ESC duty, 전류 측정 또는 전기·추진 결합 보정이 아니다.
source.bench_table_origin: V1 user-provided X500MotorSpec.png, transcribed in X500_모터_사양_확인.md
source.bench_table_status: retained_V1_transcription; table columns inspected; not a new physical benchmark or image re-reading
source.source_image_license: not established in retained V1 material; no new open-license claim and no image redistribution

assumptions.normalization: min(command_rad_s, command_max_rad_s) / command_max_rad_s; only finite nonnegative commands are accepted
assumptions.low_throttle: below the first knot: motor_current_a[0] * (throttle / throttle[0])^2; assumed, not measured
assumptions.within_table: piecewise linear interpolation, no above-table extrapolation
assumptions.auxiliary_current: 0.5 A constant retained V1 auxiliary-load assumption, not measured avionics current
assumptions.time_integration: previous accepted current is held over [previous_sim_time_s, sim_time_s), only while dt <= max_gap_s
assumptions.max_gap: 0.5 s simulation-time safety policy, not a battery material property or network wall-time timeout
assumptions.pause: equal simulation timestamps do not integrate; a fresh command at the same timestamp may replace instantaneous demand
assumptions.temperature: not modeled; no numeric temperature is returned
assumptions.voltage_feedback: none: reported voltage changes do not change modeled current or Gazebo motor force
